faq.question: What does Bakari mean?
faq.answer: Bakari is associated with the Arabic form بَكْرِي, whose core sense is bakari; young camel; from abu bakr (swahili form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Bakari?
faq.answer: Bakari is associated with Arabic. Bakari is the Swahili form of Arabic بَكْرِي, the relative form of بَكْر, associated with the name of Abu Bakr.

faq.question: Is Bakari an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form بَكْرِي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Bakari an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Bakari can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Bakari a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Bakari should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Bakr is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.answer: In Urdu, Bakari is rendered بکری and carries the sense بکری، ابوبکر سے منسوب.

faq.question: What does Bakari mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Bakari is rendered بکری and carries the sense بکری، منسوب به ابوبکر.

faq.question: How is Bakari pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is ba-ka-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.question: What are the variants of Bakari?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Bakari, bakari. Script forms are بَكْرِي, بکري, بکری, बकरी.
